import re
PFX = re.compile(r'^==(?P<pid>\d+)==(?P<rest>.*)$')
THREAD = re.compile(r'^ Thread #(?P<thread>\d+) was (?P<event>\S.*?)\s*$')
LOCKANN = re.compile(r'^\s+Lock at (?P<address>0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+) was (?P<event>\S.*?)\s*$')
RACE = re.compile(r'^ Possible data race during (?P<access>\w+) of size (?P<size>\d+) at (?P<address>0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+) by thread #(?P<thread>\d+)')
CONFLICT = re.compile(r'^ This conflicts with a previous (?P<access>\w+) of size (?P<size>\d+) by thread #(?P<thread>\d+)')
LOCKS = re.compile(r'^ Locks held: (?P<locks>\S.*?)\s*$')
FRAME = re.compile(r'^\s+(?P<at>at|by) (?P<address>0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+): (?P<function>\S.*?) \((?P<location>[^()]*)\)\s*$')
SYMBOL = re.compile(r'^\s+Address (?P<address>0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+) is (?P<offset>\d+) bytes inside (?P<kind>\S.*?) "(?P<symbol>[^"]*)"')
SUMMARY = re.compile(r'^ ERROR SUMMARY: (?P<errors>\d+) errors from (?P<contexts>\d+) contexts \(suppressed: (?P<serrors>\d+) from (?P<scontexts>\d+)\)')
SKIP = re.compile(r'^\s*$|^ (?:-{3,}|Helgrind, a thread|Copyright \(C\)|Using Valgrind|Command: |Use --history-level|the cost of reduced|For lists of detected)')

def parse(lines):
    threads, lockrecs, races, frames, out, summary, skip = [], [], [], [], [], [], []
    tl, kl, rl, fl, ol, sl = [], [], [], [], [], []
    owner, depth = None, 0
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        p = PFX.match(ln)
        if not p:
            out.append({'line': ln})
            ol.append(i)
            continue
        pid, rest = p.group('pid'), p.group('rest')
        m = THREAD.match(rest)
        if m:
            threads.append({'pid': pid, 'thread': m.group('thread'), 'event': m.group('event')})
            owner, depth = {'race': '', 'part': 'announcement', 'thread': m.group('thread'), 'lock': ''}, 0
            tl.append(i)
            continue
        m = LOCKANN.match(rest)
        if m:
            lockrecs.append({'pid': pid, 'lock': m.group('address'), 'event': m.group('event'),
                             'symbol': '', 'symbol kind': '', 'symbol offset': ''})
            owner, depth = {'race': '', 'part': 'lock', 'thread': '', 'lock': m.group('address')}, 0
            kl.append(i)
            continue
        m = RACE.match(rest)
        if m:
            races.append({'pid': pid, 'race': len(races) + 1, 'access': m.group('access'),
                          'size': m.group('size'), 'address': m.group('address'),
                          'thread': m.group('thread'), 'locks held': '',
                          'conflict access': '', 'conflict size': '', 'conflict thread': '',
                          'conflict locks held': '', 'symbol': '', 'symbol kind': '', 'symbol offset': ''})
            owner, depth = {'race': len(races), 'part': 'access', 'thread': m.group('thread'), 'lock': ''}, 0
            rl.append(i)
            continue
        m = CONFLICT.match(rest)
        if m and races:
            races[-1].update({'conflict access': m.group('access'), 'conflict size': m.group('size'),
                              'conflict thread': m.group('thread')})
            owner, depth = {'race': len(races), 'part': 'conflict', 'thread': m.group('thread'), 'lock': ''}, 0
            rl.append(i)
            continue
        m = LOCKS.match(rest)
        if m and races and owner and owner['race']:
            key = 'locks held' if owner['part'] == 'access' else 'conflict locks held'
            races[-1][key] = m.group('locks')
            rl.append(i)
            continue
        m = SYMBOL.match(rest)
        if m and owner and owner['part'] == 'lock' and lockrecs:
            lockrecs[-1].update({'symbol': m.group('symbol'), 'symbol kind': m.group('kind'),
                                 'symbol offset': m.group('offset')})
            kl.append(i)
            continue
        if m and races:
            races[-1].update({'symbol': m.group('symbol'), 'symbol kind': m.group('kind'),
                              'symbol offset': m.group('offset')})
            rl.append(i)
            continue
        m = FRAME.match(rest)
        if m and owner:
            depth += 1
            rec = {'pid': pid}
            rec.update(owner)
            rec.update({'frame': depth, 'at': m.group('at'), 'address': m.group('address'),
                        'function': m.group('function'), 'location': m.group('location')})
            frames.append(rec)
            fl.append(i)
            continue
        m = SUMMARY.match(rest)
        if m:
            summary.append({'pid': pid, 'errors': m.group('errors'), 'contexts': m.group('contexts'),
                            'suppressed errors': m.group('serrors'), 'suppressed contexts': m.group('scontexts')})
            sl.append(i)
            continue
        if SKIP.match(rest):
            skip.append(i)
    blocks = [{'name': 'threads', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': tl, 'records': threads},
              {'name': 'locks', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': kl, 'records': lockrecs},
              {'name': 'races', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': rl, 'records': races},
              {'name': 'frames', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': fl, 'records': frames},
              {'name': 'program_output', 'kind': 'table', 'lines': ol, 'records': out},
              {'name': 'summary', 'kind': 'kv', 'lines': sl, 'records': summary}]
    return {'blocks': blocks, 'skip': skip}
